item.text:
Refactored the SQL completion path into a shared model-layer utility instead of keeping the logic duplicated in LSP. The new provider lives in [SQLQueryCompletionContextProvider.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.sql/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/semantics/completion/SQLQueryCompletionContextProvider.java:1), and [LspSQLCompletionContextParser.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.lsp/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/lsp/context/LspSQLCompletionContextParser.java:1) now delegates to it and has smaller, separated legacy vs semantic proposal collection methods.

I also updated the semantic completion test helper in [RequestResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/test/org.jkiss.dbeaver.test.platform/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/analyzer/builder/request/RequestResult.java:1) to use the same shared provider, so tests exercise the real completion-context construction path. Then I added a focused multi-statement regression test in [SQLQueryCompletionAnalyzerTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/test/org.jkiss.dbeaver.test.platform/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/analyzer/SQLQueryCompletionAnalyzerTest.java:1) to cover off-query completion after a statement terminator and completion inside the second statement of a script.

I could not run the Tycho test target here because `mvn` is not installed in this environment. I attempted `mvn -f test/org.jkiss.dbeaver.test.platform/pom.xml -Dtest=SQLQueryCompletionAnalyzerTest test`, and it failed with `command not found: mvn`.
